categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: food manufacturing, fisheries, and other businesses including leasing. The food manufacturing segment focuses on processed food products such as surimi, ham, sausages, fish cakes, and dumplings. The fisheries segment involves tuna longline fishing, tuna purse seine fishing, pollock trawl fishing, and squid trawl fishing. Other businesses include rental income and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced production technologies including HACCP and FSSC 22000 certifications for food safety and quality management. Automated production lines are used especially in surimi manufacturing. The food manufacturing plants utilize European-style meat processing techniques and maintain high hygiene standards. In fisheries, the company uses specialized fishing vessels and engages in joint ventures and government agreements to secure fishing quotas and expand fishing areas.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic consumers and businesses purchasing processed food products, as well as major export markets such as Japan for fresh tuna. The company supplies products through its own sales headquarters and related companies with nationwide distribution networks. The fisheries segment sells mainly to Japan and domestic markets. The company also serves wholesale and retail channels through distributors and direct exports.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea with manufacturing plants located in Pyeongtaek, Geumsan, Yangsan, and Imsil. The fisheries operations cover international waters including Russia, the Falkland Islands, and other global fishing grounds. Export markets include Japan and other countries. The company is part of the Sajo Group, leveraging group-wide economies of scale.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and midstream in the supply chain. In fisheries, it is upstream by directly harvesting seafood resources. In food manufacturing, it is midstream by processing raw materials into finished food products. It also engages in downstream activities through sales and distribution via its sales headquarters and affiliated companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous new product development to meet diverse consumer demands and enhance product differentiation. The company invests in R&D for innovative processed food products such as oven-baked steaks, various sausages, and vegan-certified items. It emphasizes quality improvement, cost reduction, and automation in production. In fisheries, strategic focus is on securing fishing quotas, expanding fishing areas, and improving operational efficiency to enhance profitability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of processed food products and harvested seafood. The company earns income from domestic sales, exports, and leasing activities. Sales are conducted via direct sales, distributors, and export channels, with payment terms including cash, credit sales, and irrevocable letters of credit for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Korean food and fisheries companies such as Dongwon F&B, Hansung Enterprise, and CJ in processed foods, and Dongwon Industry and Shilla Trading in fisheries. It holds a notable market share in surimi products and participates actively in the tuna and pollock fishing sectors. The company is positioned as a mid-to-large player with strong production capacity and a diversified product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending 2023, the company reported total sales of approximately 391.5 billion KRW and a net profit of about 20.3 billion KRW, reflecting a 5.7% increase in sales and a 58% increase in net profit compared to the previous year. Total assets stood at approximately 346.2 billion KRW with equity of 220.8 billion KRW, showing steady growth and improved profitability. The company maintains a solid capital structure with a debt-to-equity ratio of about 56.8%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes consumer trust and satisfaction through high-quality, safe, and hygienic food products certified by international standards such as HACCP and FSSC 22000. It differentiates itself by offering a diverse product range including traditional European-style meat products, automated surimi production, and trend-responsive items like vegan-certified foods. In fisheries, it leverages extensive operational experience and strategic quota acquisition to ensure stable supply and profitability. Synergies with affiliated companies enhance distribution and brand strength.
